desc:
# Agent Python Tools

- repo: facebookresearch/kats
- repo_uri: https://github.com/facebookresearch/kats

## File: facebookresearch_kats/kats/tsfeatures/tsfeatures.py

Prompts

```
['create a python module that uses TsFeatures.transform to extract all statistical and seasonal features from a time series', 'build a script that calls TsFeatures.get_stl_features to compute trend strength, seasonality strength, and spikiness from a numpy array', 'create a function that uses TsFeatures.get_acfpacf_features to extract autocorrelation and partial autocorrelation features from time series data', 'build a python module that calls TsFeatures.get_statistics to compute mean, variance, entropy, lumpiness, and stability features', 'create a script that uses TsFourierFeatures.get_features to compute sine and cosine Fourier features for a given period and order']
```

Usage

```
{'transform_tsfeatures': 'create a python module that uses TsFeatures.transform to extract all statistical and seasonal features from a time series', 'get_stl_features': 'build a script that calls TsFeatures.get_stl_features to compute trend strength, seasonality strength, and spikiness from a numpy array', 'get_acfpacf_features': 'create a function that uses TsFeatures.get_acfpacf_features to extract autocorrelation and partial autocorrelation features from time series data', 'get_statistics': 'build a python module that calls TsFeatures.get_statistics to compute mean, variance, entropy, lumpiness, and stability features', 'get_fourier_features': 'create a script that uses TsFourierFeatures.get_features to compute sine and cosine Fourier features for a given period and order'}
```
name: facebookresearch_kats/kats/tsfeatures/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_kats/kats/tsfeatures/ts.transform_tsfeatures: create a python module that uses TsFeatures.transform to extract all statistical and seasonal features from a time series
facebookresearch_kats/kats/tsfeatures/ts.get_stl_features: build a script that calls TsFeatures.get_stl_features to compute trend strength, seasonality strength, and spikiness from a numpy array
facebookresearch_kats/kats/tsfeatures/ts.get_acfpacf_features: create a function that uses TsFeatures.get_acfpacf_features to extract autocorrelation and partial autocorrelation features from time series data
facebookresearch_kats/kats/tsfeatures/ts.get_statistics: build a python module that calls TsFeatures.get_statistics to compute mean, variance, entropy, lumpiness, and stability features
facebookresearch_kats/kats/tsfeatures/ts.get_fourier_features: create a script that uses TsFourierFeatures.get_features to compute sine and cosine Fourier features for a given period and order
